messages:
Priya: Quick postmortem follow-up. We surfaced three recurring pain points: (A) missing frontend spans intermittently, (B) hourly aggregation skew for signup_count, (C) periodic ETL consumer lag. Need clear owners, short mitigations, and longterm fixes.

Omar: I'll take the ETL consumer lag. Initial read: consumer lag spikes are correlated with GC pauses on the kafka-consumer pool after a recent JVM bump. Short term: pin JVM flags + roll back to previous heap tuning. Long term: rewrite hot-path to non-blocking I/O or migrate to the Go consumer. ETA: rollback and metrics watch today, proposal for longterm in two weeks. :wrench:

Lea: I'll own the aggregation skew. I observed late-arriving events being assigned the previous hour bucket because the watermark update happens at the end of the batch. Plan: add event-time watermark advancement mid-batch and enforce idempotent merges. ETA: patch + integration test in 4 days.

Jin: I'll look at the missing spans. Repro is deterministic on large POSTs where our frontend gzip interceptor strips tracestate header when Content-Encoding is set. Suspect the gzip middleware order change in last deploy. Plan: add header preservation and fuzz tests. Canary in staging tomorrow. ETA 48h for canary.

Priya: Good. Let's capture mitigation steps plus metrics to watch for each. Also propose a 3-week cadence: weekly 20m async check-ins + daily channel updates until all mitigations validated. If anything slips >2w we escalate to eng leadership.

Omar: Mitigation steps (added to checklist):
- rollback JVM tuning for kafka-consumer pool to previous GC flags
- temp scale consumers x1.5 during peak window (02:00-04:00 UTC)
- add consumer.lag alarm at 5m

AlertBot: [alert] kafka-consumer-lag > 300s for topic analytics-raw during 02:43 UTC. See: https://monitoring.redwood/kafka/topics/analytics-raw/alerts/8123

Lea: Aggregation checklist snippet I'll add:
```
- Add watermark advance at 50% batch completion
- Enforce merge idempotency via (partition, window_start, checksum)
- Add regression test with late event TTL and timezone transitions
- Watch metrics: agg.window_skew, agg.duplicate_count
```

Jin: Tracing repro command I used in staging (forces large payload):
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Content-Encoding: gzip" -H "tracing-level: debug" --data-binary @big-payload.gz https://staging.frontend/internal/collect
```
Observed: tracestate header missing on 3/10 requests. Working on header-preserve patch.

Priya: Action owners + deadlines:
- Omar: ETL consumer rollback + monitoring changes; rollback today, follow-up proposal by 2026-04-04
- Lea: aggregation patch + tests; PR by 2026-03-31, e2e pass by 2026-04-03
- Jin: tracing header fix + staging canary; patch and canary by 2026-03-29
- Priya: spin up shared checklist + schedule weekly async updates (owner: Priya)

Lea: I'll also add a data-quality alert that counts per-hour deltas vs baseline and fires if deviation >5%. That should catch regressions before they hit downstream dashboards.

Omar: Rolled back JVM flags and bumped consumers to 12 -> 18 for the nightly window. Watching consumer.lag and GC.pause_time.

Jin: Pushed header-preserve change to staging: https://git.redwood/internal/tracing/patches/88. Starting 24h canary now.

AlertBot: [note] Canaries started for tracing header-preserve change (canary-id: trace-preserve-88).

Priya: Thanks. Please post short status updates in this thread daily. I'll compile a single remediation table and attach to the postmortem doc.

Lea: PR opened: https://git.redwood/internal/agg/merge-fix/pull/117 5% tests failing around late events, iterating.

Omar: GC.pause_time dropped after rollback. Consumer lag stabilized during the window. Keeping monitoring for 48h.

Jin: Canary passed first 6h with 0 missing spans. Continuing 24h run. If green, I'll schedule rollout to canary cluster next Tue.

Priya: If anyone hits blockers ping me. I'll add owners to the postmortem record and create the 20m weekly check invites. :calendar:
